maya: quick micro-pulse — two quick items, keep it short pls

maya: 1) Onboarding: finished initial eval harness for model-bridge v2 (spanish promptset + rerank). Ran smoke at 512 tok. Results look ok but one sticky regression on polite-requests slice.

tony: nice. can you paste the failing examples?

maya: sure, snippet below (outputs truncated):
```
INPUT: ¿Puedes ayudarme a reservar un vuelo?
EXPECTED: Sí, ¿cuándo y dónde te gustaría volar?
OUTPUT: Lo siento, no puedo ayudar con esa solicitud.
```

sophia: ugh that looks like a safety/overfiltering flip. Did you run with the new quant profile?

maya: yes — tinyq-v2 (int8-ish) + updated safety-filters from last week. Turning quant off reverts the failure.

liam: can we reproduce locally with the eval command?

maya: yep — run: `python eval/run_eval.py --model path/to/v2 --promptset spanish_polite --max-toks 512 --seed 42`

dev-bot: CI: onboard-harness/Spanish-smoke · build passed · 7m ago

tony: thanks. blocker_for_rollout?

maya: soft blocker. plan: 1) open short CR to tweak filter threshold in safety layer (small change), 2) run A/B with 5% traffic to quantized variant (canary), 3) if metrics stable push to 50%. Need someone to review CR and approve canary routing.

sophia: I can review the CR today (ping me when ready).

liam: I'll own the canary routing change + monitoring dashboard. pinging infra-alerts for synthetic checks.

maya: thanks. also quick FYI — noticed KV warmup difference: v2 seems to use ~8% more warmup tokens on long conversations; probably due to attention cache layout. Filing issue #789.

tony: good catch, that could impact tail latency. can you add a small perf sample to the issue?

maya: done (attached sample + flamegraph link).

sophia: last tiny ask — any open CRs to merge before EOD that touch rerank code? I want to avoid merge conflicts with my safety tweak.

maya: only the safety-threshold CR (will mark WIP until reviewed).

liam: ack. I'll queue the canary rollout for tomorrow 10:00 UTC after we have CR review.

maya: great — action items:
- maya: open CR for safety-threshold tweak (WIP)
- sophia: review CR today
- liam: prepare canary routing + dashboard (tomorrow 10:00 UTC)
- tony: follow up on KV warmup perf samples

maya: anything else?

tony: nope, thanks all :thumbsup:

sophia: thanks — will review in next hour :eyes:

liam: noted, will post canary runbook once prep is done.

maya: closing short pulse, will update thread after CR lands.
